summary: SUIC Worldwide Holdings filed an 8-K/A reporting that on July 10, 2026 it signed a share exchange agreement to acquire 51% of Taiwan Vision Renu Corporation from Chairman Chen for 30,000,000 SUIC common shares. The same event triggered a change in control and management overhaul: Chen King Te became Chairman/CEO, Kho Jean Jean CFO, and Dongsheng Zou a director representing Faith Glory Charity Foundation, the largest holder with 40 million shares. Mechanics involve share issuance and a new control bloc; no price per share, premium, advisor, or close date beyond signing was disclosed.
